CustomField.description: Date the year-end tax receipt was issued to the donor for this gift. Manual field — year-end tax receipting is out of scope for FQS automation. Standard NPC batch tax-receipt capabilities own the delivery mechanism; this field records the outcome for reporting and audit. Complements the standard Tax Receipt Status picklist. See .planning/fqs-gift-followup-redesign.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date this gift's tax receipt was issued to the donor. Enter manually or via a bulk update after your annual tax-receipt run.
CustomField.label: Tax Receipt Date
